selected_captures.title: The quiet editing screen
selected_captures.sequence: Fresh fingerprinted reference boot.
selected_captures.notes: The document begins at the first cell. The status occupies the final row toward the right. There is no application title or permanent shortcut toolbar.

selected_captures.title: The original keyboard vocabulary
selected_captures.sequence: F3, then F3 again.
selected_captures.notes: The app teaches its modifier families. F11 Reveal Codes and F12 Block are present in the Enhanced template. Treat the keyboard template as an acceptance surface, including Ctrl combinations with original meanings.

selected_captures.title: A menu carries more than labels
selected_captures.sequence: Alt+=, F.
selected_captures.notes: Borders, separators, red mnemonic letters, right-aligned shortcuts and submenu arrows make the menu readable. The live File menu differs from the later manual inventory used in the preview.

selected_captures.title: Unavailable commands have a visual state
selected_captures.sequence: Right from File.
selected_captures.notes: Several entries are bracketed. The original communicates availability before activation. Wordling currently presents several entries whose only action is an unimplemented message.

selected_captures.title: Groups express the document model
selected_captures.sequence: Move across the menu bar to Layout.
selected_captures.notes: Line, Page, Document and Other form one group. Columns, tables and math form another. Preserve these groupings, borders and shortcut columns.

selected_captures.title: Submenus attach to the selected row
selected_captures.sequence: Alt+=, L, J from the saved sample.
selected_captures.notes: The Justify submenu opens alongside its parent row, while the parent remains visible. The current preview puts child menus at the top of the screen and loses this relationship.

selected_captures.title: An unresolved cancellation detail
selected_captures.sequence: F1 from the Justify submenu, followed by an explicit wait.
selected_captures.notes: The submenu remained visible in two attempts. The manual describes F1 backing up a level. Automatic reopening, focus and timing need a controlled follow-up. Do not turn the manual expectation into an observed result.

selected_captures.title: Visibility is a real original preference
selected_captures.sequence: Shift+F1, 2 Display, 4 Menu Options.
selected_captures.notes: The pinned profile has Alt-key activation and Menu Bar Remains Visible both set to No. Separator-line and mnemonic/text appearance settings also exist.

selected_captures.title: A persistent menu is historically supported
selected_captures.sequence: Menu Options, 8, Y.
selected_captures.notes: This changes Menu Bar Remains Visible to Yes in the scratch guest only. The selected profile must include this preference when we compare Wordling with the original.

selected_captures.title: Visible menus and editing focus coexist
selected_captures.sequence: F7 from Setup after enabling persistent visibility.
selected_captures.notes: The menu bar remains visible above the text and the editor resumes. This is the reference for the user's preferred visible-menu experience.

selected_captures.title: Attributes have specific screen appearances
selected_captures.sequence: Type the sample, using F6 and F8 around two words.
selected_captures.notes: Bold and underline have distinct renderings. The underline word uses contrasting cells in this profile. Faithfulness includes attribute colors and cursor shape, beyond terminal bold and underline escapes.

selected_captures.title: Reveal Codes is a second document view
selected_captures.sequence: Alt+F3 on the formatted three-line sample.
selected_captures.notes: Paragraph structure appears in both panes. The upper pane ends with status, then a red ruler with margin and tab markers. Codes and content span multiple lower-pane lines. The bottom line explains how to restore the screen.

selected_captures.title: Wrapping follows document geometry
selected_captures.sequence: Shift+F3 to Doc 2, then type the research sentence.
selected_captures.notes: The 122-character paragraph wraps before the right edge of the 80-column display. The status advances to Ln 1.17 inches. Terminal width and printed text width are separate concerns.

selected_captures.title: A soft return is visible and meaningful
selected_captures.sequence: Alt+F3 on the wrapped paragraph.
selected_captures.notes: The original displays [SRt] at the wrapping boundary. This connects layout, cursor navigation and Reveal Codes. A view that merely splits on hard returns cannot reproduce this interaction.

selected_captures.title: Save leaves the document in view
selected_captures.sequence: F10 in Doc 1.
selected_captures.notes: The bottom line becomes Document to be saved. The document remains visible, with prompt input focus. This requires explicit modal state and reliable cancellation.

selected_captures.title: Search uses the same prompt grammar
selected_captures.sequence: Home, Home, Up; F2; type bold.
selected_captures.notes: The bottom line shows -> Srch: bold. Search needs its own input semantics, including native code searches. It is a core editing workflow.

selected_captures.title: Search returns to editing at the match
selected_captures.sequence: F2 completes the entered search.
selected_captures.notes: The prompt disappears and the physical position changes to 2.2 inches. Text content remains intact. We need to compare cursor placement as well as the presence of a result.

selected_captures.title: F5 starts with a directory request
selected_captures.sequence: F5 from editing.
selected_captures.notes: The current document remains visible while the bottom line asks for Dir C:\WP51\*.*. The hint explains how to change the default directory.

selected_captures.title: The full List Files screen
selected_captures.sequence: F5, accept the default directory, Down.
selected_captures.notes: The dense two-column list has DOS name/extension alignment, directory entries, dates, a divider, scrolling indicator, red header and full-row selection. Statistics distinguish document size from disk file size.

selected_captures.title: A selected native file
selected_captures.sequence: Enter C:\OUT\ at the directory request, then Down.
selected_captures.notes: STUDY.WP is selected. The original displays an in-memory document size of 347 and a disk file size of 397. These fields must be measured according to their original definitions.

selected_captures.title: Look has its own screen and navigation
selected_captures.sequence: 6 with STUDY.WP selected.
selected_captures.notes: The header shows the path, WP5.1 type and revision time. The footer offers Next Doc and Prev Doc. This view previews a file without replacing the current editing document.

selected_captures.title: Returning preserves browser context
selected_captures.sequence: F1 from Look.
selected_captures.notes: The list and selected STUDY.WP return. Browser state is part of the experience, including the current directory, selected item and chosen operation.

selected_captures.title: Even an unmodified document has an exit flow
selected_captures.sequence: F7 from the saved document.
selected_captures.notes: Save document? appears with the Text was not modified annotation. Implement the actual defaults and prompt transitions rather than a generic modern confirmation dialog.

selected_captures.title: Unsaved exit is a distinct case
selected_captures.sequence: F7 from the unsaved wrapped Doc 2.
selected_captures.notes: The original asks Save document? Yes (No), while preserving the visible text and persistent menu. Compare this with the saved-document case.

selected_captures.title: Closing Doc 2 has its own confirmation
selected_captures.sequence: N at the Doc 2 save question.
selected_captures.notes: The prompt is Exit doc 2? No (Yes). Confirming it returns to Doc 1. This differs from terminating the application.

selected_captures.title: The final document controls application exit
selected_captures.sequence: After closing Doc 2, F7 and N in Doc 1.
selected_captures.notes: The prompt is now Exit WP? No (Yes). Y returns to the DOS prompt. A single generic Exit state would miss this distinction.

limits: FreeDOS 1.4 and the pinned Standard Printer resources are the established reference profile, not an untouched 1992 shipping environment.
This is qualitative observation from one scratch guest. These sequences have not been independently repeated as acceptance tests.

Initial captures 09, 11 and 12 were premature. Captures 18-19 and 25 show directory prompts rather than a successful Look preview. Captures 26-31 and 44 arose during unsuccessful navigation. They are retained as raw evidence and excluded from the board.
F1 submenu cancellation is unresolved. The report distinguishes manual expectations from observations.
Mouse hover/drag, alternate display adapters, graphics preview, startup splash, printer output and full feature parity were not evaluated.
